spans.s: शिशन् (only शिश्ना) = शिश्न॑.
शिशय॑ a. communicative, liberal.
शिशयिषु a. wishing to lie down, sleepy.
शिशिरकर m. the moon (having cold rays).
शिशिर˚किरण m. the moon (having cold rays).
शिशिरदीधिति m. the same.
शिशिर˚मयूख m. the same.
शिशिरय् शिशिर˚यति to cool (trans.).

शिशिरांशु a. having cold rays;
 m. the moon.
शिशिरात्यय m. spring (end of the dewy season).
शिशिरात्यय m. spring (end of the cool season).
शिशिरर्तु m. the cool season of the year.
शिशिरसमय m. the cool season of the year.
शिशिरी@कृ = शिशिरय्.
शि॑शु m. young, child.
शिशुक॑ m. young, child.
शिशुकाल m. childhood.
शिशुकृच्छ्र n. a kind of penance.
शिशुचान्द्रायण n. the lunar penance of children.
शिशुजन m. sgl. (coll.) children.
शिशुता f. ˚त्व n. childhood.
शिशुनाग m. a young snake.
शिशुपाल m. N. of a king slain by Kṛṣṇa.

शिशुपालवध m. the slaying of Śiśupāla, T. of
an epic poem by Māgha.
शिशुभाव m. childhood, childishness.
शि॑शुमन्त् a. having children or young.

शिशुमा॑र m. the Gangetic porpoise (lit. child-killing)
& a constellation conceived in the form of this animal and as an
apparition of Viṣṇu.
शिशू॑ल m. a little child.
शिश्न॑ m. n. tail or the membrum virile.
शिश्न॑थ m. piercing, perforation.

शिश्न॑देव m. pl. a class of tailed demons or false
gods.

2 शिष्ट॑ a. left, remaining;
 n. rest, remainder.
शिष्टप्रयोग m. the use or practice of learned men.
शिष्टभक्ष m. the eating of leavings.
शिष्टसभा f. an assembly of learned men.
शिष्टागम m. the tradition of learned men.
1 शिष्टाचार m. the conduct of well-bred men.
2 शिष्टाचार a. behaving like well-bred men.
शिष्टादिष्ट a. approved by wise men.
1 शिष्टि f. punishment, command, instruction.
2 †शिष्टि f. help, aid.
शिष्यक m. = prec. m.

शिष्यरूपिन् a. having the form or appearance of a
scholar.
सिषास॑तु a. desiring to obtain.
सिषा˚स॑नि a. desiring to obtain.
सिषासु॑ a. = prec. or = seq.
†सिष्णु a. desiring to give.
सिसृक्षा f. desire of creating.
सिसृक्षु a. desiring to create.
सी॑स n. lead.
सीसक n. lead.
